tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i yang zlog gi man ngag rdo rje pha lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

oṃ swa bhā ba sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnam lcags rdo rje'i lter// ru dra glang rgod chu glang zung bzhi'i steng*// pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan dbus su// hūm̐ yig mthing nag yongs su gyur pa las// bdag nyid tshe bdag nag po sku mdog mthing*// sku che yan lag rags pa ri rab mnyam// zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche gtsigs sdang mig bsgrad// ag tshom me 'bar smin ma glog ltar 'khyug /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pas 'khor lo ni// rtsibs brgyad rno ngar ldan pa nam mkhar phyar// g.yon pas sdigs mdzub dang bcas lcags kyu dang*// zhags pa bsnams shing ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ sgras// ri rab 'gul zhing rgya mtsho 'khyom pa dang*/ khams gsum g.yo zhing sde brgyad 'byung po kun// 'dar zhing sngangs nas 'bog cing brgyal bar byed// 'jigs rung che btsan 'gran zla bral bar gyur// de yi gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan// thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros lho phyogs kyi// 'og min gnas nas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa// spyan drangs dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis med thim// slar yang gzi brjid 'od zer 'bar bar gyur// phyag g.yon lcags kyus dgra bgegs byad ma bkug /mdun du sgyel zhing lcags kyus snying nas bzung*// zhags pas ske bcings sdigs mdzub kyis bsdigs pas/ kha 'dar lus sbrid skyob pa'i lha dang phral// rdo rje'i phyi rol gnam lcags 'khor lo dang*// phyag g.yas 'khor los mgo lus dum bur gtubs// sha khrag gshin rje'i tshogs kyis rjes med zos// lhag ma bskal mes bsregs shing rlung gis gtor// thal ba rdul phran bzhin du brlag par gyur/ oṃ hūm̐ trig khroṃ bh+yo: ma ni mā ra ṇi bh+yo: mā ra du na bh+yo: rak+mo rak+shan: ting ya rak+sha bh+yo: dgra bgegs byad ma mā ra ya: ya ma rā dza: kī la ya bh+yo:1$0000250 'di yi yan+t+ra ni/ dang po srung ba'i 'khor lo ni/ 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad mu khyud bskor/

lte bar che ge mo la srungs shig /rtsibs brgyad la sngags tshan brgyad bkod/1$0000300 yig mgo phyir blta/ 1$0000250mu khyud la dbyangs gsal ye dharmā bri/ de rgyab rdo rje'i ra ba me ri g.yas skor bri/ dri bzang gis byugs la rab gnas bya/ drod dang ma bral bar mgul lam dpung g.yon btags te skabs su 'khor lo bskul bar bya/ zlog 'khor ni/ lte bar 1$0000300 che ge mo 1$0000250zlog dang*/ rtsibs brgyad la sngags tshan brgyad dang*/ tha ma la me ri g.yon skor bri'o// 1$0000300 srung ba'i dmigs pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnam lcags rdo rje'i lter// ru dra glang rgod chu glang zung bzhi'i steng*// pad+ma nyi zla sogs gong ltar nas/ slar yang gzi brjid 'od zer 'bar bar gyur// bar dang*/ thugs kar gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i dbus// rin chen las grub 'od 'bar mchod rten gyi// bum nang nyi zla kha sbyor nang du hūm̐// tha mar sngags phreng ā li kā lis bskor// hūm̐ mthing nang du bsrung bya mtha' dag sba// rtsibs steng 'jam dpal dbyangs zhi ba dmar ser ral pod can/ bzhis nang gzigs srung*/ srung sngags bzla'o/ ༈ /zlog pa dang gsad pa'i skabs/ rtsibs bzhir 'jam dpal dmar nag ral gri dang*// zhags 'dzin dur khrod chas gsol dor stabs bzhugs// zhal phyir gzigs te zlog pa'i las mdzad gyur// 1$0000250zlog gsad kyi bcas ni/ dug shog la liṅga dbang po tshang ba'i dpral bar rus/ snying gar ming*/ lte bar bla dwags rnams dmod sham can du bri/ phyi nas zlog sngags kyis g.yon du bskor/ dza khram nyer gcig bri/ stegs bu khru gang bar mar la brub khung gru gsum nag po brus pa'i nang du bcug /rtsang gis bskor/ de'i steng lcags snod du 'bru'i ngar phye gson khrag gis sbrus par dmar gtor bcas la rtsang mtshe 1$0000300 1$0000250yungs kyis brgyan/

de la liṅga pra tshil gyi rū pa can spyi gtsug tu btsug /sāts+tsha dkar nag gi 'phrul 'khor kyang 'grub na legs/ 1$0000300 thun rdzas sogs 'du byas la/ phyag g.yon lcags kyus dgra bgegs byad ma bkug /mdun du sgyel zhing lcags kyus snying nas bzung*// zhags pas ske bcings sdigs mdzub kyis bsdigs pas/ kha 'dar lus sbrid skyob pa'i lha dang phral// liṅgar thim pas dgra bo dngos su gyur/ na mo: sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang: chos kyi bka'= dge 'dun gyi bka'= bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka'= yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bka'= mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyi bka'= sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi bka'= dpal mgon ma ning nag po'i bka'= khyad par tshe bdag nag po'i bka'= sngags 'chang bdag gi sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa dang: bden pa chen po'i mthus: dgra bo byad ma lha dang bcas pa'i bla srog rnam par shes pa gar yod gar gnas kyang skad cig rang dbang med par dmigs pa'i rten 'di la khug cig: ces bzla 'o// dgra bo'i bla sha re ma ti 'grim 'grim/ sha ma ru ti thul thul/ myogs myogs/ yed yed/ sha ma ru ti khug khug /ling myogs/ ling shag /ling thums dzaḥ tsa mun+t+ri dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes bzla 'o// rdo rje'i phyi rol gnam lcags 'khor lo dang*// phyag g.yas 'khor los mgo lus dum bur gtubs// sha khrag gshin rje'i tshogs kyis rjes med zos// lhag ma bskal mes bsregs shing rlung gis gtor// thal ba rdul phran bzhin du brlag par gyur/ oṃ hūm̐ trig khroṃ bh+yoḥ sogs yig 'bru so drug pa 'don/ de yang rak+mo rak+shan: ting ya rak+sha bh+yo: zhes pa dag go / lag gnyis gnam sa'i bar du dgra bo bcar// lus sems stobs nus rmeg med brlag par gyur/ na mo: sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang: chos kyi bka'= dge 'dun gyi bka'= bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka'= yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bka'=

mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi bka'= sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi bka'= dpal mgon ma ning nag po'i bka'= khyad par du dpal tshe bdag nag po'i bka'= sngags 'chang bdag gi sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa dang: bden pa chen po'i mthu stobs byin rlabs nus pa la brten nas: rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la: chag che ba: nyam nga ba: rmi lam ngan pa: mtshan ma ngan pa: ltas ngan pa: pha rol gyi rmis ltas: rbod gtong rbad 'dre: byad kha: zor kha: phur kha: gtad kha: khyad par du zlog pa byed pa'i mthu dang nus pa thams cad zlog mkhan kho rang gi steng du zlogs shig: rang gshed rang la phob cig: rang srog rang gis chod cig: rang sha rang gis zo zhig: rang khrag rang gis thungs shig: kho rang gi lha srung thams cad kho rang gi gshed du phob cig: bdag gi chos skyong thams cad kyang kho'i gshed du phob cig: mā ra ya zlog zlog: bh+yo bh+yoḥ brgya phrag re song nas thal rdeb lan gsum re bya/ thun mtshams su mthar sgrub gtor dgra phyogs su 'phang ste/ bh+yo: gshin rje gshed po 'khor bcas kyis: da lta rnal 'byor bdag cag la: sde brgyad chad pa byung ba zlogs: byad zor phur kha ston pa zlogs: lha 'dre'i za kha zug pa= rgyal po lo yi bdun zur= blon po zla ba'i dbang btsan= dmag mi zhag gi dpung dgra= mtshon cha dus kyi rno ngar= spar kha'i skya mda' zug pa= sme ba dur du tshud pa= sa bdag ko long gdug rtsub= hom dang byad du bcug pa= dgra chen bdud du langs pa= ltas ngan glo bur ye 'drog= mi kha bra mchu thams cad= chag che nyam nga thams cad= sngon sgug phyi nas 'ded pa= dgra sna phung sna gyod sna= nad sna rims sna yams sna= dgra sri rmis ngan thams cad= che sri chung sri rgan sri= gzhon sri dar sri dur sri= mdor na srid pa'i chag sgo dang: bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs rnams: sdang byed dgra bo'i steng du zlogs:

gnod byed bgegs kyi steng du zlogs: za 'dre phung sri'i steng du bh+yo: dam nyams byad ma'i steng du bh+yo: bh+yo: nyi ma lho phyogs pha ki na: rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og nas: las kyi gshin rje'i dmag tshogs rnams: khri dang drug stong 'khor dang bcas: rgyal chen phyogs skyong pho nyar 'gyed: lha 'dre stong sde las la 'dzud: kun kyang 'ur sgra chems se chem: phyag na zlog pa'i kong zor thogs: rang rtags mtshon cha me ltar 'bar: sngon nas byad zor zlog pa'i lha: dmar chen gtor ma 'di bzhes la: do nub zlog pa'i dpung la chos: dgra dpung g.yul ngo zlog par mdzod: ya ma rā dza dgra bo'i snying la bh+yo bh+yo: zhes pas zlog cing bskul lo// nyin tha ma la brub khung gi liṅga dang gtor ma'i rtse'i rū pa la thun gyis brab cing mtshon chas gtubs la bsgral te brub khung du tsher ma'i me sbar la dug khrag gis bran nas/ skad cig me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil du// ru dra glang rgod chu glang zung bzhi'i steng*// pad+ma nyi zla sogs gong ltar nas/ slar yang gzi brjid 'od zer 'bar bar gyur// bar dang*/ dgra bo byad ma lha dang bcas pa kun// me dpung 'bar ba'i zhal du bstab par gyur// sngags kyi mthar/ kī la ya bh+yo: dgra bgegs byad ma mā ra ya dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes pas ling ro me hom du brgya rtsa brgyad du phul nas mthar/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes pas lha gshegs nas thal ba mnan dong du bcug la/ e/ rang nyid dpal chen gshin rje'i gshed po yi// phyag g.yas ral gri brgyabs pas sa gzhi gas// rim bdun sa 'og gshin rje'i grong khyer nas// las kyi gshin rje a wa glang gi mgo /gnam sa tsam gyi zhal gdangs 'o dod 'bod// de tshe snang srid lha 'dre thams cad kyis// gnod byed dgra bgegs mi kha bra mchu rnams// thams cad ded nas las gshin zhal du blug /bh+yo: nyi ma lho phyogs sogs gong ltar nas/ snying la bh+yo bh+yo:

bar dang*/ gtor ma dgra bo nyid dang dbyer med pa// las gshin zhal du 'phangs pas rab tu mnyes/ kha bsdams 'og phyogs gshin rje'i yul du song*// de steng rgya mtsho gser gyi sa gzhi chags// de steng ri rab gling bzhi gling phran brgyad// ri rab steng du 'jam dpal lha tshogs dang*// gling bzhir rgyal chen bzhi po dpung dang bcas// snang srid sde brgyad kun gyis mnan par gyur// sngags mjug tu/ gnod byed dgra bgegs mi kha bra mchu thams cad mā ra ya rbad nan: dgra bo sa yi khams suṃ nan: me'i khams raṃ nan: chu'i khams baṃ nan: rlung gi khams yaṃ nan: nam mkha'i khams e nan: rnam par shes pa'i khams s+t+waṃ bha ya nan: zhes bzlas thun gtor 'phang*/ gnan pa'i las rnams bya 'o// de lta bu'i yang zlog gi man ngag 'dis ni gzhan gyis byas pa'i ngan byad rnams zlog cing*/ rang nyid kyis brtsams pa'i 'phrul 'khor dang gnan sreg gi sbyor ba rnams kyang tshur la mi ldog pa'i yang zlog ste/ rata gling dang*/ 'ja' tshon dang*/ bde chen gling pa'i gter kha gsum tshig don zhus dag pher bar bzhugs pa las/ 'di rnam snang lo tsā'i sgyu 'phrul gter ston chen po pad+ma bde chen gling pa'am hūm̐ nag bde gshegs snying po rtsal gyi zab gter las byon pa ltar rig pa 'dzin pa rdo rje tshe dbang nor bu phrin las 'gro 'dul rtsal gyis ljags sgrig gi 'don cha la/ gter gzhung gi man ngag rnams 'khor lo'i mgon po kun mkhyen chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi zhal lung ltar rgyal khams pa tshe dbang kun khyab kyi reg zig ste dza yan+tu/ maṅga laṃ/// /
